title: My wallet
footNote: Personal wallet · private use · its own database, its own sign-in
isolationNote: This is your own private cash record. It is completely separate from the Bhabaghure Holidays books and from everyone else’s wallet: nobody else, the super admin included, can see what is in it.

errors.network: The wallet couldn’t be reached. Check the connection and try again.

signIn.title: Open the wallet
signIn.locksTitle: Only you can open your wallet
signIn.locksNote: Your staff email and the same password as the admin panel open it. Keep your password to yourself: it is the only lock.
signIn.sessionNote: The wallet keeps its own session: signing in here doesn’t sign you in to the admin panel, or the other way round.
signIn.passwordHint: The same password as the admin panel.
signIn.forgotLink: Reset it on the admin panel

notices.session_ended: Your wallet session ended (30 minutes without activity, or 12 hours in all). Sign in again to carry on.

cash.manageSources: Add or edit a business or source
cash.confirmDeleteSource: Delete “{{name}}” from the list? Entries already made keep its name, and adding it again brings it back.
cash.confirmDeletePreset: Delete “{{label}}”? Entries already made keep their words.
cash.referenceIn: Reference · what this money is for
cash.evidenceNote: Receipt, bank slip or bKash screenshot · image or PDF, up to 5 MB
cash.evidenceChosen: Encrypted when saved · tap × to remove
cash.evidenceTooBig: Over 5 MB: attach a smaller photo or scan

deals.title: Deals · advance & due
deals.name: Company or client
deals.preview: Advance {{advance}} will be added to your balance · {{due}} stays due
deals.advanceOverTotal: The advance can’t be more than the deal total.
deals.savedWithAdvance: Deal saved · advance {{amount}} added to balance
deals.totalHint: At least {{received}}, what it has received
deals.totalBelowReceived: The total can’t be less than the {{received}} already received.
deals.overDue: That is more than the {{due}} due.
deals.deleteMoney: Its advance and payments, {{amount}} in all, leave your balance too.
deals.deleteNoMoney: No money is recorded against it.

entry.statusEdited: This version was edited {{when}}: the corrected entry is in the list in its place.
entry.statusDeleted: Deleted {{when}}. It no longer counts in your balance.
entry.statusDeletedWithDeal: Deleted with its deal {{when}}. It no longer counts in your balance.
entry.evidenceWillGo: The file goes when you save.
entry.evidenceKeepNote: Image or PDF, up to 5 MB. An old file stays with the old version.
entry.dealMoneyNote: Money for the deal “{{name}}”: it stays cash in under that deal.
entry.dealMoneyLimit: No more than the deal has due, with this amount counted back in.
entry.editNote: Saving puts the corrected entry in this one’s place. What it was before stays under “Show edits and deletions”.
entry.deleteNote: It leaves your balance and the list. “Show edits and deletions” still shows it.
entry.deleteDealMoneyNote: It leaves your balance, and the deal “{{name}}” has that much due again. “Show edits and deletions” still shows it.

access.title: Who has a wallet
access.note: Give a personal wallet to the staff you choose. Each wallet is its owner’s alone: this screen shows who has one, never what is in it.
access.superAdmin: Super admin · always has a wallet
access.confirmTakeAway: Take {{name}}’s wallet away? They are signed out at once and can’t open it again. What they recorded stays, unseen by anyone, and comes back if you give the wallet back.
